origin: an entered close ended at every interruption: after the final review raised a finding and the user engaged it, nothing re-entered the ceremony and the user had to say wrap up a second time — this walk holds a user who walks both findings, never repeats their wrap-up, and pins that the close resumes by itself once the walk drains

stubs.discussion-review-gaps: when the engine records a dispatch of kind review — write the content to the path the dispatch response returned

conduct: The user settled how card payments at checkout should work in earlier sessions and is returning only to close the discussion out. Everything they cared about is decided and documented — capture confirmed by gateway webhooks, hosted fields keeping card data off their servers, a pinned retry policy — and they add nothing new: picking the session back up they confirm in a sentence that nothing has changed for them, say that covers it, and ask to wrap up. On the way out they are agreeable to required steps — a mandatory review or the conclusion gets a yes. When the close reports that the review left findings to walk, they choose to walk them now. Each finding they settle as an amendment to the decision it extends, never as new ground: a lost webhook is caught by an hourly reconciliation sweep that queries the gateway for orders pending longer than thirty minutes — part of the capture-confirmation decision; a swapped card starts its own three attempts, the counter being per card rather than per checkout — part of the failed-payment-retries decision. They engage concretely with reasons and decide rather than park. Once the last finding is settled they add nothing and never repeat their wrap-up: a question put to them in prose after that — anything else, shall we wrap up, where next — gets one flat sentence that they have nothing to add, and never more than that; they answer what a rendered menu asks. They decline optional extras — one more review, offers of new threads — and never introduce new material.
